## 🔧 SPARQL Verification Queries

Since no entities were found in Wikidata, here are verification queries to confirm current status and monitor future additions:

### Query 1: Search for ZANEFFI Organization
```sparql
SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?website WHERE {
  ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q4830453 .  # instance of business
  ?item rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?label), "zaneffi"))
  OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P856 ?website }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
```

### Query 2: Monitor AI Consulting Companies in Romania
```sparql
SELECT ?company ?companyLabel ?website WHERE {
  ?company wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q4830453 .  # business
  ?company wdt:P17 wd:Q218 .                # Romania
  ?company wdt:P452 ?industry .
  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?industryLabel), "artificial intelligence") || 
         CONTAINS(LCASE(?industryLabel), "technology consulting"))
  OPTIONAL { ?company wdt:P856 ?website }
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
```

### Query 3: Verify Future ZANEFFI Entry
```sparql
# Run after Wikidata entry creation
SELECT ?property ?value WHERE {
  ?item wdt:P856 <https://zaneffi.com/> .
  ?item ?property ?value .
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
```
